1.1.title: Term
1.1.text: This agreement starts on January 1, 2026 and runs for 24 months.

1.2.title: Renewal
1.2.text: The agreement renews automatically for 12 months unless either party gives 60 days written notice.

2.1.title: Fees
2.1.text: The client pays a monthly fee of $2,500, due on the 5th day of each month.

2.2.title: Late Payment
2.2.text: Payments more than 15 days late incur a late fee of 1.5% of the unpaid amount.

3.1.title: Confidentiality
3.1.text: Each party must keep the other party's confidential information private for 5 years after the agreement ends.

3.2.title: Data Storage
3.2.text: Client data is stored in the United States and deleted within 30 days after termination.

4.1.title: Termination for Cause
4.1.text: Either party may terminate for cause with 30 days written notice if the other party breaches the agreement and does not fix the breach.

4.2.title: Termination for Convenience
4.2.text: The client may terminate without cause with 90 days written notice.

5.1.title: Liability
5.1.text: Total liability for either party is limited to the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.

5.2.title: Governing Law
5.2.text: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Tennessee.
